newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ACT Networks cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ACT Networks cut.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist said it cut its rating on shares of ACT Networks Inc to hold from buy after ACT's report of "very disappointing" fiscal Q4 results.
-- ACT earned $0.01 a share on $13.4 million in sales versus a forecast of $0.18 a share on sales of $15.6 million.
-- Hambrecht attributed the shortfall to higher than expected operating costs, problems integrating acquisitions and lack of sales and marketing leadership.
-- said ACT's management "has not demonstrated that it can execute its business plan."
-- ACT shares were off 1-7/8 at 12-1/8 by midday.
